prohibited_operations: Do not edit, format, rename, move, delete, restore, reset, stash, stage, commit, or overwrite original project files.
Do not kill, pause, restart, signal, reconfigure, or attach a debugger to Kimi or existing services.
Do not send instructions to the active Kimi session.
Do not change port 8000, port 5188, shared environment files, user-level environment variables, proxy settings, installed packages, or the existing virtual environment.
Do not run pytest from the original repository (its conftest.py creates a directory under the original .pytest_cache even before ordinary tests execute).
Do not import the original application to inspect routes; configuration and imports can create directories or initialize data.
Do not call existing service routes that can fetch upstream data, write caches, or launch subprocesses.
Do not execute build-syllabi.mjs, refresh tools, batch crawlers, or source verification commands against the live workspace.
Do not copy a live SQLite database by copying only its .db file; do not access a live database during Phase A - use synthetic fixtures or already exported immutable evidence.
Do not run git clean, git reset --hard, broad recursive deletion, a blanket formatter, a dependency upgrade, or a lock-file regeneration in the original project.
Do not interpret the plan as authorization to resume the stopped CIE batch.
Do not automatically promote staging changes after tests pass.

gates_record.rule: All seven gates start false. Only explicit human instructions open a gate, and each opened gate must record the human instruction text, timestamp, scope, and constraints. original_paths_released alone opens none of the others.

concurrent_change_rule: Owner changes are expected; never restore an earlier hash to make a protection check pass, and record unexpected original-file changes as concurrent observations (plan section 0.9).
